Package com.github.crittscott.somestacks.block

Class StorageStackBE

java.lang.Object
net.minecraft.world.level.block.entity.BlockEntity
com.github.crittscott.somestacks.block.StackBlockEntity
com.github.crittscott.somestacks.block.StorageStackBE
public class StorageStackBE extends StackBlockEntity
One Storage Stack: 27 item stacks drawn as a 3 x 3 x 3 grid.

The block owns its own slots, but it is not the unit of storage. A vertical run of these is a StoragePile, and deposits, capability access, sorting and packing all act on the whole run. Everything here that reaches past this block's own slots resolves the pile first.

Capability exposure (ForgeCapabilities.ITEM_HANDLER or its Fabric equivalent) is loader-specific and lives outside this class. Automation adapts StackBlockEntity.itemRun() for whole-pile access; StackBlockEntity.getItems() exposes only this block's local slots.

      @Nullable public StoragePile pile()
      Returns the server pile containing this block, or null on the client or when removed. Delegates to StackBlockEntity.itemRun(), whose per-tick cache is invalidated by structural edits.
